Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2000 ) 
SPECIFICATION FOR PISTON RINGS FOR IC ENGINES 

PART IV NAPIER OIL SCRAPER RINGS 
FROM 30 UP TO 200 mm NOMINAL DIAMETER 

N-RINGS 



1 . Scope — Specifies the dimensions, tolerances, tangential loads and other details of N-rings (napier oil 
scraper rings) from 30 up to 200 mm nominal diameter for internal combustion engines. 

2. Dimensions and Tolerances — Shall be as given in Table 1 read with Fig. 1 . 




TOP 



=ri5 



EDGE MUST TOUCH 
CYLINDER IN TENSIONED 
CONDITION 



DETAIL A 
SHOWING CHAMFERING OF 
INTERNAL EDGES(KI) 

FIG. 1 DIMENSIONS FOR N-RINGS 

3. Designation — Shall include: 

a) Type of ring; 

b) Nominal diameter, d x ; 

c) Axial width, h x \ 

d) Number of this standard ; 

e) Material symbol ; 

f) Manufacturing process; 

g) Whether internally bevelled (IF) ; and 
h) Type of coating. 

Example: 

A napier oil scraper ring (N-ring) having a nominal diameter ^=90 mm, axial width /? x =2*5 mm, 
made of alloyed cast iron (A4), internally bevelled (IF) and phosphated on all sides (P), shall be 
designated as: 



N-Ring 90x2-5 IS : 8422 (Part IV) A4 IF P

For other materials load 



IS : 8422 (Part IV) -1977 

4. General Requirements — Shall be as given in IS : 5791-1977. 

5. Marking — The rings which are to be fitted in a particular direction shall be marked with the word TOP' 
on the top sides of the rings. For other markings reference should be made to IS : 5791 -1 977. 

5.1 JSf Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXP LAN ATO R Y NOTE 

This Standard is one of the series of Indian Standards on piston ring dimensions, tangential force, etc. 
IS : 5791 -1 977 is a necessary adjunct to this standard which gives details of materials, surface finish, gap 
types and sizes, surface coatings, manufacturing processes, etc. 

In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the prevalent sizes in the 
industry. It is recommended that for new designs, only the sizes given in this standard be used. 

In the preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from DIN 70930 'Piston rings for 
automotive engineering, N-rings, oil-scraper rings from 30 up to 200 mm nominal diameter', issued by 
DIN Deutsches Institut fiir Normung. 



Printed at Sree Saraswaty Press Ltd, Calcutta, India
